skill_name: Formulate an argument for or against a given action.
workflow: An argument in support of banning plastic bags could be that they are a major source of pollution and contribute to environmental damage. Plastic bags are non-biodegradable, take hundreds of years to break down, and can be dangerous to wildlife. A ban on plastic bags would reduce this pollution, and encourage the use of more environmentally-friendly alternatives.
